declared.description: The minimum subtotal is parsed but never enforced.
The minimum is compared with the whole cart subtotal instead of the eligible subtotal.
Once any line is eligible, the percentage is taken from the whole cart.
Breaks backward compatibility: a discount without eligibility takes nothing off.
